source_review.notes: Checked all eight official sources for identity, authority, version or publication status, and bounded claim scope. OpenTelemetry Specification 1.60.0 supports stable immutable Context, attach/detach, Propagators, Baggage, and non-OTLP log-correlation claims. The W3C Trace Context Recommendation and current W3C Baggage specification support carrier syntax, validation, privacy, security, and representation limits. RFC 9110 supports HTTP field and intermediary distinctions. Current OpenTelemetry context-propagation guidance supports sensitive-data cautions. Checked 2026-09-06.

notation_and_syntax.notes: Checked partial maps, map update, function notation, sums, inequalities, products, ratios, and TeX delimiters for GitHub rendering.
